content.title: I live near a trail (or open space/park). When should I expect to see parks staff pruning the trees in these areas?
content.summary: With more than 30,000 trees on City property, maintaining them properly is a labor-intensive task. Pruning and other tree maintenance can be expected year around. Learn about tree removal in City parks.
